title: Google’s News AI pilot expands to over 400 publications
summary:
X author: @NiemanLab

Nieman Lab reported that Google expanded its News AI pilot program to more than 400 publications, including many U.S. local news outlets.

Linked sources:
- https://www.niemanlab.org/2026/10/googles-news-ai-pilot-expands-to-over-400-publications-including-u-s-local-news-outlets/

title: Meta removes language from terms that allowed scraping news sites for AI training
summary:
X author: @verge

The Verge reported that Meta removed language from its terms of service that experts said permitted scraping of news sites to train its AI models.

Linked sources:
- https://www.theverge.com/tech/1013409/meta-removes-language-that-may-have-allowed-it-to-scrape-news-sites

title: Popular web services are blocking AI agents from acting on behalf of users
summary:
X author: @verge

The Verge reported that OpenAI, Meta, and Google are building AI agents for web tasks, but many popular services are blocking them from operating.

Linked sources:
- https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1013195/ai-agents-blocked-web
